about: Exa is a US artificial intelligence search company based in San Francisco, formerly known as Metaphor. It builds a search engine and API designed for AI applications, letting developers and AI agents retrieve relevant web content using neural embeddings and natural-language queries. Customers are AI developers and enterprises, and it is backed by venture investors, with about 357 million dollars raised. B2B developer tool with strong standing among AI engineers and no consumer brand awareness.

about: Domain name registry operator that runs hundreds of top-level domains such as .live, .email, .world and .company, and operates the Afilias legacy registry business, including .info and .org-related services under the Public Interest Registry exception. Based in Bellevue, Washington, it was formed in 2021 when Donuts acquired Afilias and then rebranded as Identity Digital, and has registrars worldwide as customers. Revenue comes from domain registrations and renewals. B2B with strong awareness in the domain industry and a growing profile among startups.

Customers are gamers, travellers and workers buying online and through retailers. Backed by venture funding and growing quickly through direct sales and partners. about: Austin, Texas maker of sports nutrition and energy brands, led by C4 pre-workout and C4 Energy drinks, plus Cellucor, XTEND amino drinks and other supplements, sold through Walmart, Target, Costco, GNC, Amazon and convenience stores. A major shareholder since 2022 is KKR, which invested at a reported multi-billion-dollar valuation. Sells to fitness-minded consumers in the US and internationally. Strong consumer awareness among gym-goers and a natural fit for sports sponsorship.

Health technology company based in the Seattle area (Bellevue) that sells gut microbiome tests and personalised supplements, using stool, blood and saliva samples to recommend diets and probiotics, and offers products under the Viome Health Intelligence banner. Founded in 2016 by Naveen Jain, with investors including Khosla Ventures, and sells mainly online direct to consumers. Moderate US consumer awareness through health and wellness marketing.

Software company based in San Francisco, offering hospitality technology for hotels, including digital check-in, contactless payments, guest messaging, upsell tools and digital tipping, sold on subscription. Founded in 2016 and backed by venture investors including Kleiner Perkins and Index Ventures, with thousands of hotels and major chains as customers. B2B hospitality technology brand, known in the travel industry but not to the public.

US account-based marketing and sales software company providing AI-enabled tools that help business-to-business marketers identify target companies, personalise ads and prioritise outreach. Customers include enterprise technology and manufacturing firms who pay annual software subscriptions, and the product integrates intent data and advertising. Founded in 2006 as a lead gen tool, it grew over time into account-based marketing. Raised capital from investors including Bain Capital, and has hundreds of employees. B2B with well-known brand in marketing technology circles, little consumer awareness.

California cybersecurity vendor (Palo Alto Networks) selling firewalls, cloud security and AI-driven security platforms to enterprises and governments globally, with tens of thousands of customers and annual revenue of about $9 billion. Platforms include Prisma Cloud, Cortex and Prisma Access, plus acquisitions such as CyberArk. Founded in 2005. Nasdaq listed as PANW. B2B with strong tech brand awareness.

wiki.title: Palo Alto Networks
wiki.text: Palo Alto Networks, Inc. is an American multinational cybersecurity company with headquarters in Santa Clara, California. The core product is a platform that includes advanced firewalls and cloud-based offerings that extend those firewalls to cover other aspects of security. The company serves over 70,000 organizations in over 150 countries, including 85 of the Fortune 100. It is home to the Unit 42 threat research team and hosts the Ignite cybersecurity conference. It is a partner organization of the World Economic Forum. In June 2018, former Google and SoftBank executive Nikesh Arora joined the company as Chairman and CEO.

about: Boston-based SEO and online marketing software maker (Semrush), selling subscription tools for keyword research, competitor analysis and content. Also offers social media, advertising and AI-visibility tools used by agencies, marketers and in-house teams, with paying customers in the tens of thousands across markets. NYSE-listed (SEMR) since 2021. Adobe agreed in late 2025 to acquire it for about $1.9 billion. Millions of users, B2B brand known in marketing circles.
